text:
nina: quick q — ribbon above projects or transient spotlight for first-run?

owen: ribbon low fuss, spotlight higher clicks.

carmen: spotlight needs focus management; ribbon easier for SR users.

leo: infra estimate: ribbon ~3d, spotlight ~6d due to layering + focus trap.

a11y-bot: accessibility must-haves: aria-live polite announcement, visible focus indicator on CTAs, aria-label on dismiss, respects prefers-reduced-motion.

nina: proposal: default ribbon, spotlight behind feature-flag for 10% A/B. both variants must meet AA contrast, keyboard tabbable CTAs, and persist dismiss via localStorage.

eng-bot: telemetry events: onboarding.impression, onboarding.cta_click (props: project_slug), onboarding.dismiss. experiment flag: onb_ui_variant=ribbon|spotlight. kill-switch included.

nina: copy vote: primary `Try sample project`, secondary `See sample projects`, dismiss visible `Not now` with aria-label `Dismiss onboarding banner`. posting figma + ticket ONB-3019 for details. quick review after PR. :sparkles:
